newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends $4 down, Brent at new session low.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends $4 down, Brent at new session low.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed sharply lower on Monday, while Brent crude hit a new session low in late afternoon trade.
June gas oil ended the day $4.25 a tonne down at $160.00, having caught up with Brent's late losses on Friday.
"Gas oil was just following the rest of the market lower," said one broker.
July Brent was trading seven cents down at $17.63 a barrel at 1645 GMT, having just touched an intra-day low of $17.60.
"It's still reeling from the shock of all the fund liquidation throughout last week," said one broker.
"It's not showing any signs of recovery yet."
Dealers saw support for Brent around $17.54 a barrel, the yearly spot low on the continuation chart.
